m: 1. परी in comp. for परि.

2. परी (परि-√ इ) P. पर्य्-एति (Impv. परीहि, MBh.; Pot. परीयाम्, TS.; impf. पर्यैत्, ŚBr.; pf. परीयाय, TS.; fut. पर्य्-एता, ChUp.; ind.p. परीत्य, PārGṛ.; पर्य्-आयं, Br.; inf. पर्य्-एतवे, RV.), to go about, move in a circle; (trans.) to go or flow round (acc.), circumambulate, surround, include, grasp, span, RV. &c. &c.; to run against or into, reach, attain, AV.; ŚBr.; ChUp.; (with or sc. मनसा) to perceive, ponder, MBh.; R. : Intens. Ā. परीयते, to move round or in a circle, RV.
a: परी — (परि-इ) {c2c} P. 1 To go round, circumambulate; (चरणन्यासं) भक्तिनम्रः परीयाः Me. 55; Ms. 2. 48. --2 To surround, encompass; हुतवहपरीतं गृहमिव Ś. 5. 10; विषवल्लीभिः परीताभिर्महौषधिः R. 12. 61; so कोपपरीतमानसं Ki. 2. 25. --3 To go to, think of (objects &c.). --4 To be changed or transformed. --5 To reach to. --6 To run against.

a: परीक्ष् — {c1c} A. 1 To examine, look at or scrutinize carefully; अतः परीक्ष्य कर्तव्यं विशेषात्संगतं रहः Ś. 5. 24; संतः परीक्ष्यान्यतरद्भजंते M. 1. 2; Ms. 9. 14. --2 To test, try, put to the test; मायां मयोद्भाव्य परीक्षितोऽसि R. 2. 65; यत्नात्परीक्षितः पुंस्त्वे Y. 1. 55 ‘carefully tested as to potency’. --3 To observe, perceive.

dApayet । yAjYavalkyenABiyokturvAdinaH SirovarttitvABiDAnAdaBiyojyasya divyakarttftvaM pratipAditam । vyaktamAha kAtyAyanaH । “na kaScidaBiyoktAraM divyezu viniyojayet । aBiyuktAya dAtavyaM divyaM divyaviSAradEH ॥” pratyarTisvIkAreRArTino'pi divyamAha yAjYavalkyaH । “rucyA vAnyataraH kuryyAditaro varttayecCiraH । vinApi SIrzakAn kuryyAnnfpadrohe'Ta pAtake ॥” itaro'BiyuktaH SiraH SArIradaRqamarTadaRqaM vA varttayet svIkuryyAt । bfhaspatiH । “snehAtkroDAlloBato vA BedamAyAnti sAkziRaH । viDidfzwasya divyasya na Bedo jAyate kvacit ॥” BedaH satyAdvEparItyam । yattu kAtyAyanavacanam । “kriyA na vEdikI proktA vidyamAnezu sAkzizu । leKye ca sati vAdezu na syAddivyaM na sAkziRaH ॥” iti tadguRAnvitasAkzisattve । yaTA vyAsaH । “maRimantrOzaDibalAt pradattaM vA SapaTAH proktA manunA svalpakAraRAt ॥” bfhaspatiH । “yaToktaviDinA deyaM divyaM divyaviSAradEH । ayaToktapradattantu na SaktaM sADyasADane ॥ adeSakAladattAni vahirvAdikftAni ca । vyaBicAraM sadA tvevaM kurvvantIha na saMSayaH ॥” vahirvAdikftamaBiyoktAraM vinA kftam । etacca prAyiktaM AtmaSudDiparARAmaBiyoktAraM vinApi divyaviDAnAt । taTA ca nAradaH । “rAjaBiH SaNkitAnAYca nirddizwAnAYca dasyuBiH । AtmaSudDiparARAYca deyaM divyaM Siro vinA ॥ * ॥” aTa divyadeSAH । kAtyAyanaH । “indrasTAne'BiSastAnAM mahApAtakinAM nfRAm । nfpadrohapravfttAnAM rAjadvAre prayojayet ॥ prAtilomyaprasUtAnAM divyaM deyaM catuzpaTe । ato'nyezu ca kAryyezu saBAmaDye vidurbuDAH ॥” indrasTAne indraDvajasTAne ॥ * ॥ aTa divyakAlAH । pitAmahaH । “cEtro mArgaSirAScEva vESAKaSca taTEva hi । ete sADAraRA mAsA divyAnAmaviroDinaH ॥ DawaH sarvvarttukaH prokto vAte vAti vivarjjayet । agniH SiSirahemantavarzAsu parikIrttitaH ॥ SaradgrIzme tu salilaM hemante SiSire vizam । kozastu sarvvadA deyastulA syAt sArvvakAlikIti ॥” mitAkzarAyAM nAradaH । “na SIte toyaSudDiH syAnnozRakAle'gniSoDanam । na prAvfzi vizaM dadyAt pravAte na tulAM nfpa ! ॥” nAradaH । “pUrvvAhRe sarvvadivyAnAM pradAnaM parikIrttitam । nAparAhRe na sanDyAyAM na maDyAhne kadAcana ॥” SIte hemantaSiSiravarzAsu । uzRakAle grIzmaSaradoH । varzAsu vizanizeDaScaturyavAtiriktaparaH । vaze caturyavA mAtrA iti vakzyamARanAradavacanAt । taRqulAdInAntu viSezAnaBiDAnAt sArvvakAlikatvam । atra vize viSezato varzAnizeDAt vakzyamARavacane siMhasTaravAveva parIkzAmAtranizeDAccadivyAntaraM siMhetaratra varzAsvapi kurvvIta । vyatoyAsyAyane harO supte sarvvakarmmARi varjjayedityasya na vizayaH । jyotize । niMhasTe makarasTe ca jIve cAstamite taTA । malamAse na karttavyA parIkzA jayakANkziRA ॥ raviSudDo gurO cEva na Sukre'staNgate punaH । “siMhasTe ca ravO nEva parIkzA Sasyate buDEH ॥ nAzwamyAM na caturddaSyAM prAyaScittaparIkzaRe । na parIkzA vivAhaSca SaniBOmadine taTA ॥ raviSudDO gurO cEvetyatra Sasyata iti SezaH ॥ taTA ca dIpikAyAm । “no SukrAste'zwame'rke gurusahitaravI janmamAse'zwamendO vizwO mAse malAKye kujaSanidivase janmatArAsu cATa । nAqInakzatrahIne gururavirajanInATatArAviSudDO prAtaH kAryyA parIkzA dvitanucaragfhAMSodaye Sastalagne ॥” * ॥ pitAmahaH । “pratyakzaM dApayeddivyaM rAjA vADikfto'pi vA । vAhmaRAnAM SrutavatAM prakftInAntaTEva ca ॥” brAhmaRAnAM prakftInAYca pratyakzaM divyaM dApayedityanvayaH । prakftayastu । “svAmyamAtyaH muhft kozo rAzwradurgabalAni ca । rAjyANgAni prakftayaH pOrARAM SreRayo'pi ceti amarasiMhoktAH ॥ * ॥ aTa divyaviSezADikAriRaH । nAradaH । “brAhmaRasya Dawo deyaH kzattriyasya hutASanaH । vESyasya salilaM deyaM SUdrasya vizameva tu ॥ sAzAraRaH samastAnAM kozaH prokto manIziBiH । vizazarjjaM brAhmaRasya sarvvezAntu tulA smftA ॥” yat punaranena । “mavratAnAM BfSArttAnAM vyADitAnAM tapasvinAm । svIRAYca na BaveddivyaM yadi DarmmastvapekzitaH ॥” iti stryAdInAM divyaM nizidDaM tattuletaravizayakamiti SUlapARiH ॥ mitAkzArAyAntu । stropuMsayorvvivAdena strIRAM divyamiti rucyA vAnyataraH kuryyAditi vikalpanizeDArTametaduktaM Bavati । avazwabDABiyogezu stryAdInAmaBiyoktftve aBiyojyAnAmeva divyaM etezAmaBiyoge yojyatve'pi aBiyoktFRAmeva divyaM parasparABiyoge tu vikalpa eva tatrApi tulEveti niyamyate । taTA mahApAtakAdiSaNkABiyoge tu stryAdInAM tulEva । yaTA yAjYavalkyaH । “tulA strIbAlavfdDAnDapaNgubrAhmaRarogiRAm । agnirjalaM vA SUdrasya yavAH sapta vizaYca vA ॥” strImAtraM jAtivayo'vasTAviSezAnAdareRa bAla ApoqaSAdvarzAjjAtiviSezAnAdareRa vfdDo'SItipAragaH । etacca vattanaM sarvvadivyasADAraRezu mArgaSiraScEtravESAKezu stryAdInAM sarvvadivyasamavaDAnaviDAne niyamArTakatayArTavat । na ca sarvvakAlaM strIRAntulEveti । “strIRAntu na vizaM proktaM na cApi salilaM smftam । DawakozAdiBistAsAmantastattvaM vicArayet ॥” iti vizasalilavyatiriktaDawakozAdiBiH SudbiviDAnAt । evaM bAlAdizvapi yojanIyam । taTA brAhmaRAdInAmapi na sArvvakAlikastulAdiniyamaH । “sarvvezAmeva varRAnAM kozAcCudDirviDIyate । sarvvARyetAni sarvvezAM brAhmaRasya vizaM vinA ॥” iti pitAmahasmaraRAt । tasmAt sADAraRe kAle bahudivyasamavaDAne tulAdiniyamArTamevedaM vacanam । kAlAntare tu tattatkAlavihitaM sarvezAm । taTA hi varzAsvagnireva sarvvezAM hemantaSiSirayostu kzattriyAdInAM trayARAM agnivizayorvikalpaH brAhmaRasya tu agnireva na kadAcidvizaM brAhmaRasya vizaM vineti nizeDAt । grIzmaSaradostu salilameva । yezAM kuzWyAdInAntu viSezeRAgnyAdinizeDaH । “kuzWinAM varjjayedagniM salilaM SvAsakAsinAm । pittaSlezmavatAM nityaM vizantu parivarjjayediti vacanAttezAmagnyAdikAle'pi sADAraRaM tulAdyava divyaM Bavati । yaTA । toyamagnirvizaYcEva dAtavyaM balinAM nfRAmiti smaraRAt । durbbalAnAmapi sarvvaTA vizanizeDAt tatkAlAnatikrameRa jAtivayo'vasTASritAni divyAni deyAni । atra ca yasya yAni viSezasAmAnyaparyyudastetaravihitAni tAni muKyakalpAnukalparUpARi veditavyAni । yaTA, brAhmaRasya Dawo muKyaH kozastvanukalpaH । jalAgnI ApatkalpO prAguktanAradavacane
